subject: general
question: Which sportsperson among the following was honoured with the Padma Bhushan in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Devendra Jhajharia.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• The **Padma Bhushan **honor has been bestowed upon **Devendra Jhajharia**.
 
• The **Paralympic medalist **made history by being the **first Indian Paralympic **athlete to win **two gold medals.**
 
• His first gold medal came from the **Athens** **2004 Games**, and his second came from the **Rio de Janeiro Paralympics** in 2016.
 
• He also brought home the **silver**, earning his** third medal **in the** 2020 Tokyo Olympics. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **Avani Lekhara:**

 
 
• **​**Avani Lekhara is a **rifle shooter **and **Paralympian **from India.
 
• At the** Tokyo 2020 Paralympics,** she earned a **Gold Medal **in the 10m air rifle standing event and a **Bronze Medal **in the **50m rifle three positions event.**
 
 
 
• **Sumit Antil:**
 
 
• **​Javelin thrower **and **Paralympian **from India, Sumit Antil.
 
• In the men's **F64 javelin throw **category at the 2020 Summer Paralympics, he took home a **gold medal.**
 
 
 
• **Pramod Bhagat:**
 
 
• **​**Indian professional **para**-**badminton player **Pramod Bhagat is from the Vaishali district of Bihar.
 
• He earned a **gold medal **in the** Men's singles SL3** event at the 2020 Summer Paralympics and is presently rated **second **in the world in** para-badminton.**
